identities.Gauss: [H,C0]=[H,C1]=0 for the fully dressed kinematic operator
identities.constant_pair_map: commutes with each Qx and all fluxes, so its connection is zero
identities.field_dependent_map: Any smooth periodic alternative V(theta) conjugates E to E+A, A=-i V* dV; E^2 becomes E^2+AE+EA+A^2 including -i A prime. Pair creation and derivative terms are retained.
identities.local_current: J_0to1=i[H,Q1]=-i[H,Q0]; electric and Wilson-cycle pieces commute with Qx
identities.work_transport: Tr[W rho W* WHW*]-Tr[rho H]=0 for matched finite-energy states; complete instruments conjugate with W and retain I-G failure on the kinematic complement

optional_charged_counterterm.charged_number_definition: Sum of the24 positive charged Dirac occupation projections; both signs, all three families, both spins and both cells.
optional_charged_counterterm.coefficient_definition: Exact common full-source ground-energy difference; not a rounded interval endpoint or a fitted empirical coefficient.
optional_charged_counterterm.full_form_lower_bound: H_delta >= c*N_colourful+(1-delta)*N_ch+H_neutral, with c>1 and H_neutral>=0.
optional_charged_counterterm.generator_boundary: This optional member has its own H_delta evolution, currents and work; weak interactions can change N_ch. Only the reducing-sector rest values and global vacuum statement are claimed.
optional_charged_counterterm.member: H_delta=H-delta*N_ch, delta=inf spec(H_q-m)-inf spec(H_v), q=+1 or -1

resources.clock: exp(-itH) in inherited native units; no physical seconds inferred.
resources.measurement: Complete matter/flux labels and the Gauss-failure complement; spectral windows may be measured with zero mean source-energy change. No free reset is assumed.
resources.preparation: Preparing a complete matter/flux label has its stated source energy; the trial-vector Rayleigh work is reported without an autonomous preparation claim.
resources.reference: All integer R states retained; charged preparations require their compensating quantum-reference charge.

rest_operator_comparison.all_native_sectors: H-H0=alpha*((3Q1-n)^2+n^2)+t K+beta*(I-cos theta) >=0 as forms; the difference is unbounded on the full cycle carrier.
rest_operator_comparison.electron_muon_tau_rule: Each calibrated one-lepton sector gap is its inherited rest coefficient plus the common positive charged offset. Spin and charge-conjugate degeneracies are retained.
rest_operator_comparison.every_native_preparation_in_n_zero: For any normalized native finite state psi, added mean=9alpha <Q1^2>+t<K>+beta. This applies to each calibrated native rest preparation with its actual charge-square and hopping expectation.

global_vacuum_certificate.pure_neutral_sector: Q0=Q1=0 identically; H=H_v+positive neutral rest and spatial hopping. The empty matter state attains E_v.

rest_operator_comparison.three_neutral_Dirac_rule: The vacuum cycle energy cancels exactly; the symmetric spatial hopping state has zero kinetic energy. Each inherited neutral rest coefficient is unchanged in this reducing sector.

source.H0: The complete inherited native114-term interacting matter source, including all semileptonic products and calibrated coefficients.
source.d_modes: The actual48 positive Dirac annihilators of H0, including its constant charge-preserving neutral-family rotation and24 pair maps;144 colourful modes unchanged.
source.gauge_group: U(1); no independent SU(3) link field is installed
source.kinematic_carrier: Fock192 tensor l2(Z_E1) tensor l2(Z_E2) tensor l2(Z_R)
source.native_process_boundary: This is a declared source extension; no native twelve-port update generating these added terms has been proved.
source.physical_carrier: Gauss kernel unitarily equal to Fock192 tensor l2(Z_cycle)
source.self_adjoint_argument: positive electric multiplication plus bounded self-adjoint H0, spatial hopping and Wilson shifts; bounded perturbation on D(n^2)
source.source_domain: D(n^2) on Fock192 tensor l2(Z); bounded matter charges make the electric graph norm equivalent to D(n^2).
